bottlenecks.Notes: The driverless forum demonstration is evidence of technical capability, not permission for normal fare-charging service without safety operators.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Mohegan Sun kept MBody AI's robots in service after the proof of concept and converted the deployment to a paid commercial agreement; the customer has also indicated interest in a larger multi-year subscription expansion.
bottlenecks.Notes: Records an easing customer-adoption gate because a pilot converted to paid service. The proposed expansion remains under negotiation and may not occur on the stated timeline.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Tempus and ARPA-H explicitly frame specialist availability as a project-shaping constraint: less than 25% of heart-failure patients receive all guideline-recommended care and roughly 46% of U.S. counties lack a practicing cardiologist, motivating a scalable autonomous agent that can extend the clinician team.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent captures the cardiology-capacity constraint the project is designed to address; reliability, regulation and EHR integration remain separate validation requirements.

bottlenecks.Notes: Records an easing manufacturing-capacity gate because production infrastructure and the first batch exist; it does not establish that launch, on-orbit commissioning or the full 50-satellite constellation is complete.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Truist's AI Call Summaries automate note-taking and post-call documentation across care centers; the company estimates the deployment saved teammates more than 36,000 hours in Q2 2026, directly easing staff-time constraints in a high-volume customer-service workflow.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent is recorded as an easing staff-capacity constraint based on documented time savings; this does not establish headcount reduction or that staffing is unconstrained across the broader bank.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Zagreb's new fully driverless passenger rides are being conducted under approvals for autonomous-vehicle testing, while the existing commercial service has operated with an onboard AV operator; regulatory execution therefore remains a concrete gate to unsupervised commercial service.
bottlenecks.Notes: The source confirms approved driverless passenger testing, not general authorization for fully driverless fare-charging operations. Reliability remains a separate technical gate.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: NVIDIA's AI-infrastructure supply chain spans millions of parts, thousands of suppliers and global manufacturing partners; the new Palantir/Nemotron stack creates a shared command center for materials-allocation decisions and earlier constraint detection across that operational graph.
bottlenecks.Notes: Records an easing integration gate because the system is being deployed to unify operational context and allocation decisions. No measured throughput, inventory or cycle-time improvement has yet been disclosed.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: StarLink's procurement workflow previously required manual handling across email, unstructured documents, ERP validation and accounts-payable systems; the deployed agents coordinate those systems and reduced quote-comparison time from 30 minutes to 3 minutes.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is recorded as an easing workflow constraint based on a measured operating-time reduction. The 11,500 annual hours-saved figure remains projected rather than realized.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: QumulusAI completed and handed off the full contracted Blackwell B300 capacity at its Philadelphia colocation site, converting a previously announced $18 million take-or-pay agreement into live production compute for a GPU cloud marketplace.
bottlenecks.Notes: Compute is recorded as an easing gate because contracted accelerator capacity reached full customer handoff. The disclosure does not establish utilization or imply the customer's broader compute demand is fully met.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: PLDT's KAI replaces knowledge retrieval that could require up to five days of manual research with 1-3 second contextual responses grounded only in approved enterprise sources, directly easing access to usable internal knowledge.
bottlenecks.Notes: Data is recorded as an easing workflow constraint because KAI operationalizes approved enterprise knowledge. This does not establish that source quality, freshness or permissions are fully solved across PLDT.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: PLDT describes Ellie as connecting fragmented enterprise knowledge, people and workflows; the deployed assistant is reported to reduce manual effort by 25-35% and improve customer response times by up to 80%.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is recorded as easing based on the system's operating role across existing workflows and reported process improvements. Deployment breadth and measurement methodology were not disclosed.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: PLDT says increasing frequency and depth of enterprise risk reviews created a need for more scalable risk intelligence; since ERICA's February 2026 deployment, manual effort for the supported risk cycle is reported down 97-99%.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent is recorded as an easing analyst-capacity constraint, not evidence that risk professionals are removed from the loop; PLDT says human review and validation remain central.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Sportsbet is placing LLM traffic, MCP-connected tool calls and engineering AI workloads behind a self-hosted gateway, re-platforming an existing production agent and routing additional workflows through a common governance layer.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is recorded as easing because the gateway is deployed to unify governance across models, tools and agents. No measured project-level latency, adoption or cost outcome was disclosed.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: FANUC explicitly cites a global shortage of skilled welders who can optimize welding parameters and teach robot motions, which contributes to longer production lead times; the AI Welding Agent is being developed to supplement that expertise.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent remains open because the product has not yet shipped or demonstrated customer-scale relief. The project directly targets programming/setup expertise rather than eliminating skilled-welder demand broadly.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: After attacks damaged regional cloud infrastructure, Reuters reports UAE officials are reviewing the broader AI-campus design for physical resilience, including distributing facilities and considering underground, blast-resistant and air-defense measures; G42 says security and resilience specifics are under continuous review.
bottlenecks.Notes: Reliability is used as the closest stable taxonomy bucket for physical continuity/resilience risk. The reported redesign options are not yet a finalized plan and should not be treated as committed construction scope.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Cameron County's worksite permit allows Fluidstack to begin clearing, grading, utility, road and stormwater work, but additional permits remain required for future building construction, making permitting a concrete gate between site preparation and the operating campus.
bottlenecks.Notes: The worksite permit is meaningful project progress but is not full authorization for the data-center buildings or evidence that power interconnection and all later approvals are complete.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Hyundai says autonomous-driving competitiveness depends on securing high-quality real-world data and rapidly connecting it to learning and validation; its now-operating Data Flywheel uses approximately 40 dedicated collection vehicles, continuous training, hard-example mining and a standardized Data Union framework to reduce that data and feedback-cycle constraint.
bottlenecks.Notes: Data is recorded as an easing gate because a concrete collection/training/validation system is now operating. This does not establish that rare-edge-case coverage, data quality or autonomous-driving reliability are solved.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Pony.ai and GAC completed vehicle testing and validation within five months of their strategic agreement, cut the Gen-4 ADK bill-of-materials cost by 70% versus the prior generation, and are moving the T9 Robotruck toward scheduled volume production later in 2026.
bottlenecks.Notes: Manufacturing capacity is recorded as an easing gate because the program has moved through validation toward automotive volume production with a lower-cost ADK. Volume production itself is not yet verified and reliability/regulatory gates remain.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Crusoe opened a second 400,000-square-foot Tulsa factory to expand in-house production of switchgear, switchboards, controls and busbar that are directly required for AI data-center construction; the two Tulsa sites now employ more than 300 craft workers and have supplied more than 2,500 switchboards to the Abilene Stargate site.
bottlenecks.Notes: Records an easing electrical-equipment manufacturing-capacity constraint through a live factory expansion. Crusoe's days-versus-months lead-time comparison is company-reported and not treated as an independently measured benchmark.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Bitdeer AI placed A202 on the existing Johor campus so it can extend already-secured power, liquid cooling and network infrastructure rather than originate a new site, which the company says shortens the path to energization for the incremental 65.1 MW facility.
bottlenecks.Notes: Power is recorded as an easing site-development gate because A202 reuses the existing campus infrastructure. The facility is not yet energized and its 65.1 MW should not be treated as online capacity.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Roboflow's unpredictable computer-vision demand, especially around the SAM 3 launch, drove a move from a two-week GPU proof of concept to reserved Crusoe capacity; production and research now span two Crusoe data centers with dedicated headroom for latency-sensitive inference.
bottlenecks.Authority Type: Provider case study with named customer operators
bottlenecks.Notes: Compute is recorded as an easing gate because reserved capacity and two-site production now support the workload. This does not imply compute is unconstrained under future model or demand growth.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: A first-of-its-kind German Federal Motor Transport Authority permit enabled Einride and Lidl to move a cab-less SAE Level 4 truck with no onboard driver or safety operator into daily public-road retail deliveries.
bottlenecks.Authority Type: Customer/company deployment disclosure with regulator permit
bottlenecks.Notes: Regulation is recorded as an easing gate because formal approval moved the project into daily public-road operation. Expansion beyond the defined route and operating conditions remains subject to further regulatory and safety execution.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Air India's refund and name-change workflows require multiple validations, policy checks and backend actions; Agentforce now orchestrates those cross-system steps, with reported internal refund processing falling from about 14 days to 4 hours and name-change turnaround from about three days to 30 minutes.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is recorded as easing because the measured cycle-time improvements are tied to orchestrating previously fragmented validations and backend steps. Interaction volume and independent measurement methodology were not disclosed.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: At more than one million agreements per day, Docusign found general-purpose models created cost, latency and throughput pressure; moving to task-specific models and narrower context reduced AI processing costs by 90% and increased document-processing throughput by up to eight times while preserving near-comparable accuracy.
bottlenecks.Authority Type: Customer case study with named customer executives
bottlenecks.Notes: ROI/unit economics is recorded as easing because Docusign explicitly describes model economics as the scaling constraint and reports lower cost plus higher throughput after the architecture change. Results are provider-published and not independently audited.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: M42's planned Oracle Health Data Intelligence deployment is explicitly designed to centralize clinical, genomic and real-world data that currently sit across healthcare systems, making usable data unification a project-shaping prerequisite for predictive insights and precision care.
bottlenecks.Notes: Data remains open because the new platform has been announced for initial diabetes-program deployment but operating scale, migration progress and measured outcomes were not disclosed.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Voya reports that its AI-supported customer-service channels now handle 7 million annual interactions, with virtual agents achieving 85% digital resolution and 96% positive feedback, showing that customer use and acceptance have reached material operating scale.
bottlenecks.Notes: Customer adoption is recorded as easing because the self-service channel is resolving millions of interactions with high reported feedback. The figures are company-reported and do not establish that all customer segments or interaction types are suited to automation.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Fulton Bank moved from zero to more than 20 Agentforce Coworker use cases in production in weeks by running the assistant inside existing Salesforce permissions and business rules and connecting it to specialized agents already deployed.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is recorded as easing because the common governed Salesforce context let Fulton deploy many live workflows without a separate permissions or migration layer. No quantified productivity or financial result was disclosed.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Flytrex says the Rooftop Dock and predictive positioning remove two major operating costs and delays—dedicated runners and the pickup flight—and reports a 60% reduction in cost per delivery plus a 50% reduction in customer delivery time.
bottlenecks.Notes: ROI/unit economics is recorded as easing because the deployed architecture directly removes labor and flight-time costs. The improvement figures are company-reported without a disclosed baseline, sample size or independent audit.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Blockfusion's Niagara Falls AI-campus conversion uses an existing grid interconnection and low-carbon power at a former power-site campus; the definitive CoreWeave anchor lease converts that powered-site advantage into contracted AI-infrastructure demand.
bottlenecks.Authority Type: Company-issued lease disclosure with secondary corroboration
bottlenecks.Notes: Power is recorded as easing because existing interconnection and energy infrastructure shape the site's deployment advantage. The definitive announcement does not disclose contracted MW or a delivery schedule, and future construction still requires execution.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: The Nagoya pilot is explicitly testing autonomous operation in dense, complex city traffic, including right-turn control around opposing vehicles and prediction of signal changes, as part of technical validation needed before Level 4 social deployment.
bottlenecks.Speaker / Entity: May Mobility / NTT Mobility / Aichi Prefecture
bottlenecks.Notes: Reliability remains open because the program is designed to identify and improve technical and operational issues in a supervised pilot rather than demonstrate completed Level 4 commercial readiness.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Bolt replaced informal design-to-engineering handoffs with an AI-agent-enabled front-end pipeline and unified review model, allowing designers to ship working components directly into the production library and cutting routine component delivery from about one week to about one hour.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is recorded as easing because the deployment joins design, code generation and production review in one operating workflow. The cycle-time result is company-reported and does not establish that all front-end work or review is automated.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Anthropic says approximately 30,000 research and engineering agents can be active at once on its most-used internal platform, and 100% of their actions pass through online and offline monitoring; no measured subset of AI R&D is yet fully autonomous.
bottlenecks.Notes: Reliability is recorded as open because growing AI-led R&D still depends on continuous monitoring, intervention and human supervision. Anthropic analyzed more than one billion agent decisions in August and reported a 0.002% online block rate, but the measurements are company-generated.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: AWS says interconnection-study demand is outpacing the number of qualified power-systems engineers; Duke Energy is using specialized AI agents to automate data preparation, simulation execution and workflow coordination, reducing some data-preparation tasks from two weeks of manual work to hours.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent is recorded as easing because the agents increase planner capacity while engineers retain final decisions. The disclosure does not show a completed-study throughput increase or downstream reduction in actual grid-interconnection wait times.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Lucid and Bolt plan Level 4 autonomous ride-hailing across multiple European countries, but the partnership is still at the development stage and rollout must proceed through city and national operating approvals across different regulatory regimes.
bottlenecks.Notes: Regulation remains open because no partnership vehicles are yet in public commercial service and no initial approved launch city or date was disclosed. Reliability and vehicle-manufacturing execution remain separate gates.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: GlobalFoundries and Marvell expanded their multi-year agreement specifically to increase Burlington SiGe manufacturing capacity for optical interconnect components as AI data-center bandwidth demand grows.
bottlenecks.Notes: Manufacturing capacity is recorded as easing because the companies have committed to incremental production capacity on top of an existing manufacturing base. The amount and timing of the incremental capacity were not disclosed, so it should not be treated as already delivered.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Anthropic used Claude to optimize more than 30 biomolecular models for speed and memory efficiency; the resulting low-memory mode can accurately model systems above 10,000 tokens on a single NVIDIA GPU node and the optimized models run about four times faster on average.
bottlenecks.Notes: Compute is recorded as easing because the optimizations reduce runtime and memory requirements for existing scientific models. The disclosed gains are research benchmarks and do not establish external production adoption or downstream scientific output.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Joby's 3,199-mile autonomous flight still carried an onboard safety pilot, operated under remote supervision, and formed part of a tour whose related flights are being used to evaluate autonomous-airspace integration with the FAA, so regulatory integration remains a concrete gate between demonstrations and unrestricted commercial autonomous air logistics.
bottlenecks.Notes: The safety pilot made zero control inputs, so the flight is meaningful operating evidence; this signal records the supervised and regulatory framework, not a claim that the system failed technically.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Waymo says bringing fully autonomous service to Singapore requires regulatory approvals and is proceeding through a phased roadmap with the Ministry of Transport and Land Transport Authority: local fleet setup first, manual-readiness work in 2027, then a planned public commercial launch in 2028.
bottlenecks.Notes: Regulation remains open because the partnership has not yet entered public autonomous commercial service; the roadmap explicitly sequences local preparation and approvals before launch.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Oracle executives said AI has compressed code generation from work that could take a development team two to three quarters to about a week, but customer delivery has not accelerated because testing, validation, deployment and release-management processes cannot yet keep pace.
bottlenecks.Authority Type: Executive town hall reported by Business Insider
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is the closest stable taxonomy label for the downstream software-delivery pipeline bottleneck. Oracle also reported model-cost pressure and a 60-70% false-positive rate in a separate security-model test, but those are not logged as separate signals here.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Siemens was receiving more than 2,500 unqualified inbound leads each month with no scalable way to know which were worth sellers' time; two deployed AI agents now engage and qualify the full inbound stream before routing the strongest opportunities to 18,000 sellers.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent records seller-attention capacity as an easing constraint. The disclosure does not provide a measured change in conversion rate, bookings or revenue, so the signal should not be interpreted as proven financial ROI.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: HUMAIN and Applied Intuition explicitly cite workforce constraints in commercial trucking as one reason for the Saudi autonomous-trucking program; the planned network aims to increase freight capacity and fleet utilization by operating autonomous trucks for longer periods.
bottlenecks.Notes: Talent remains open because the Saudi network has been announced but not yet deployed at target scale. Reliability and regulatory execution will also matter before driverless freight can scale.
